body:

[tenpercent] They're trying so hard to gamify that app.
[ATangk] Gamifying it by hiding all the previous deal upsizes behind… actually I have no idea where they are anymore with this new update.
[tenpercent] They keep changing the user interface. It's annoying.
I used to have several stores favourited and I could see the upsize calendar with my favourites listed at the start of each day. That was probably the most useful feature they had and they just got rid of it. Apparently the stores are still favourited, but I couldn't tell you what that actually does now.
Since the favourites calendar was removed I've definitely used SB less because I just miss out on seeing the best offers I'm actually interested in.
And now for the last month or two they're trying to make it more 'exciting' and 'fun' (eye roll) with quests and badges and achievements and all the other low IQ junk to entice people to spend more.
I'll probably spend more money via SB if they just bring back the favourites calendar and stop moving everything else about.
@gotyourback please bring back the favourites calendar. It's been months and I still don't know why the useful feature was removed.
